subject: Use ccache to cache build object files to improve build time (#945)
reason: The change only adds ccache to the build and CI pipeline: a Dockerfile package install, GitHub Actions cache-restore steps and CCACHE_DIR/CCACHE_MAXSIZE environment variables, and CMAKE_C/CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER settings in CMakeLists.txt. No module source code changes, so the built module's runtime behaviour (commands, replies, indexing, persistence, replication) is unchanged between the parent and the change; there is no path a fuzzer scenario could exercise.
